question: You cut a round pizza into 8 slices using 4 straight cuts of equal angle, all passing through one point that is NOT the center. Two people take alternating slices. How do their shares compare?
choices: Whoever gets the center slice ends up with more
anchorText: they will each get an equal amount of pizza, irrespective of the central cutting point

question: Take almost any four-digit number, arrange its digits into the largest and smallest numbers possible, and subtract. Repeat on the result. You will always eventually reach the number 6174 and get stuck there.
anchorText: with at least two distinct digits will reach 6174 within seven iterations
